description: Source code for plugin management in a software project, including functions for loading and freeing plugins, both shared object (.so) and JSON-based, with external dependencies and dynamic symbol handling.

methods.name: find_number_of_objects
methods.description: Counts the number of objects in a dynamic object array.

methods.name: bbfdm_load_internal_plugin
methods.description: Loads internal plugin objects into the context, initializing object list and memory.

methods.name: bbfdm_load_dotso_plugin
methods.description: Loads a plugin from a shared object (.so) file, retrieves dynamic object symbols.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_dotso_plugin
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a loaded .so plugin, including cleanup functions.

methods.name: bbfdm_load_json_plugin
methods.description: Loads plugin configuration from a JSON file, parsing objects and managing memory.

methods.name: bbfdm_free_json_plugin
methods.description: Frees resources allocated for JSON plugins.

methods.name: bbfdm_load_external_plugin
methods.description: Determines plugin type by file extension and loads accordingly (JSON or .so).
